name: brandpilot
description: Social by Alvin's Club, an AI social media manager: plans, drafts and publishes posts for a person or a brand across X, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram and Hashnode from one brief, with your approval. Bundles the plan-social-content skill and the hosted Social MCP server (OAuth sign-in on studio.alvinsclub.ai).

brandpilot.description: Social hosted MCP server (streamable HTTP). Signs in with OAuth on first use: Gemini CLI opens studio.alvinsclub.ai in your browser; run /mcp auth brandpilot to sign in again. No token or local install.
